command:
set -euo pipefail
echo '===UNITS==='
systemctl --user cat clay-local-bridge.service frankenstein-local-bridge.service || true
echo '===SHOW==='
systemctl --user show clay-local-bridge.service frankenstein-local-bridge.service -p Id -p MainPID -p ActiveState -p SubState -p ExecStart || true
echo '===PROCESSES==='
ps -eo pid,ppid,lstart,args | grep -E '[l]ocal_bridge/daemon.py|[l]ocal_bridge_daemon.py' || true
echo '===SAFE_ENV==='
for p in $(systemctl --user show clay-local-bridge.service frankenstein-local-bridge.service -p MainPID --value 2>/dev/null | awk '$1>0'); do echo PID=$p; tr '\0' '\n' < /proc/$p/environ 2>/dev/null | grep '^LOCAL_BRIDGE_' || true; done
echo '===DB_ROWS==='
python3 - <<'PY'
import sqlite3,pathlib
db=pathlib.Path('/home/ai-core-node/.claude/star/local_bridge_state/bridge.sqlite3')
print('db',db,'exists',db.exists())
if db.exists():
 c=sqlite3.connect(db)
 for cid in ['go-avatar-gpt56sol-body-transform-authority-20260912-0842','go-avatar-gpt56sol-body-style-authority-20260912-0852','go-avatar-gpt56sol-body-sourceover-v2-20260912-0854']:
  print(cid,c.execute('select * from done where id=?',(cid,)).fetchall())
 print('done_count',c.execute('select count(*) from done').fetchone()[0])
 c.close()
PY
echo '===REPO_STATE==='
git -C /home/ai-core-node/.claude/star/local_bridge_state/repo status --short --branch || true
git -C /home/ai-core-node/.claude/star/local_bridge_state/repo remote -v | sed -E 's#(https://)[^/@]+@#\1***@#g' || true
